payload.text: The 0.1.8 sweep does not touch Intent's tree, and nothing of devbin's lands there, until Intent's v3.2.1 tag exists AND intent-vc has said yes to the sweep. This is intent-vc's ask of 2026-09-24 09:49Z (their date -u): during the 3.2.0 cut a devbin commit landed in Intent's main mid-run, and the tag carried files its tests never saw. It was relayed to cc. ALSO: when intent-vc's pre-build warning arrives, hold every devbin landing until their build is done, because devbin's commit gate runs through the intent that their build replaces.
